description: Creates <home>/skills/<name>/SKILL.md. Writes the instructions (markdown body) and the skillhook frontmatter (runner, model, auth, filters). For bearer/basic/hmac auth a secret is generated and returned once; for provider-signed auth (github, sentry, granola, stripe, slack, linear, svix, standard-webhooks) call set_secret with the provider's signing secret afterwards.

cwd.description: working directory for the agent, e.g. ~/dev/my-repo

description.description: what the skill does and when it runs (1-1024 chars)

env.description: env var names from .env to expose to the agent

instructions.description: markdown body: what the agent should do with the payload. Use {{payload}} / {{payload.some.path}} placeholders or let skillhook append the event automatically.

model.description: e.g. opus, sonnet, haiku, claude-opus-5, gpt-5-codex

secret_env.description: env var holding the secret; default SKILLHOOK_SECRET_<NAME>

name: create_skill
title: Create skill
